title: Console calibration job orchestration for quantization profiles and accuracy gates
creator: Maya Ortiz
description: Background: As we expand automated quantization support (FP8 and INT8) for curated open models, customers need a single place in Redwood Console to run, inspect, and manage calibration jobs and their artifacts. This ticket defines the product orchestration surface for calibration job runs: scheduling, artifact collection (calibration tables, histograms, per-layer error metrics), retention policies, RBAC rules, and accuracy validation gates that can automatically approve or block model rollout. The goal is a developer-friendly Console flow + stable API so platform teams can integrate calibration into CI/CD and SRE teams can audit runs for compliance.
acceptance_criteria: Console: Users can create a calibration job from model version page with selectable profile targets: FP8, INT8 or custom profile
Runs: Each calibration run is tracked as a discrete run with run-id, start/end timestamps, executor (hosted/dedicated/private), seed/inputs hash, model checksum and quantization config
Artifacts: Calibration artifacts (per-layer scale/zero-point tables, value histograms, per-token loss delta, representative dataset samples) are stored and downloadable with immutable checksums
Retention: Default retention is 90 days; team can override per-project to 30/365/forever; retention changes are audited
Permissions: Only users with role calibrator or admin can start/stop runs; viewers can see artifacts if project-level "artifact_read" granted
Validation gates: Jobs produce accuracy metrics (TOP1/ROUGE/BER depending on eval set) compared to golden baseline; threshold-based pass/fail decision surfaced in Console
Automation: API endpoint exists to trigger a run and receive a webhook on completion with result and artifact locations
Observability: Metrics emitted for run duration, artifact size, calibration failures and accuracy regression rate with dashboard and alert rule described
Security: KMS-encrypted artifact storage, audit logs for run creation/downloads exist and are surfaced to compliance team
tasks: Define run metadata schema and storage keys (run-id, model-version, config-hash, executor-tag)
Design Console UX for job creation, live run view, artifact tab and retention controls
Implement backend orchestration service to enqueue runs and attach artifacts to run metadata
Integrate KMS encryption and record audit events for start/stop/download
Add RBAC checks: roles calibrator, reviewer, viewer; map to Console actions
Expose public API and webhook contract for CI integration
Create observability dashboard and alert for calibration failures and regressions
Write e2e tests and an example CI workflow for model onboarding
audit_requirements: Record who started/stopped run and IP address
Record artifact download events with user and timestamp
Retention changes must be approval-gated for enterprise projects
retention_policy: Default 90 days for all calibration artifacts. Project owners may request 30/365/forever. Manual 'pin' on artifact makes it exempt from retention until unpinned. All retention changes generate an audit event and require "admin" role for modification.
permissions_model: Roles: admin (full), calibrator (create/stop/export runs), reviewer (approve gates, download artifacts), viewer (read-only). Additional capability flags: artifact_read, artifact_export. Private deployments can map to org SAML groups via role mapping.
run_metadata_schema: All runs must include: run_id, created_by, executor (hosted|dedicated|private), model_version, config_hash, seed, dataset_id, sample_count, hardware_profile, start_ts, end_ts, status (queued|running|succeeded|failed|canceled), artifact_manifest_uri
artifact_contents: metrics.json (per-layer RMSE, per-sequence loss delta, global accuracy metrics)
orchestration_api: POST /api/v1/projects/{p}/calibrations -> create run (body: model_version, profile, dataset_id, options)
Webhook: POST to customer endpoint with payload {run_id, status, metrics_url}
observability: Alert: >5% calibration failures in 1h -> paging to infra team
Log: structured audit events for create/download/retention-change
validation_workflow: Golden dataset: project owner selects representative eval set that's immutable for the run series
Baseline: When a model version is first onboarded, we calculate baseline metrics stored as baseline_id
Gate: User-configured thresholds (relative or absolute) cause automatic fail/pass; failing prevents automatic rollout and (optionally) triggers canary to smaller traffic
Manual review: Reviewer can inspect per-layer artifacts, compare histograms and approve an exception
Reproducibility: Each run records seed and input-sample-hash to allow byte-for-byte rerun
notes: Trade-offs: Storing full histograms for every run increases storage costs; use configurable sampling/aggregation and keep detailed artifacts for 'pinned' runs only.
Decision: MVP will keep retention defaults and 'pin' ability; 'forever' retention requires legal signoff for enterprise customers.
Follow-up: Add UI to diff two runs' artifact manifests and visualize per-layer quantization error in next cycle
